_comment: Which proposed edges the ds101 demo validates (cdlp/validation/demo_rule.py). Chosen by hand before any validation run and without the gold labels. likely_wrong_family_pairs is a guess that makes rejections likely to appear; the agent may still accept these edges. A rejection rate on this subset says nothing about the agent's quality.
selection: rule demo_subset_ds101_v1: tree-family edges first, plus edges picked because they look likely to be wrong, so that rejections can be shown; rejection counts here are not a performance measure
